BAO CAO MAY NHA  [VANG]  2026-10-08T08:30:27
TOM LAI:
  - Chua do toc do may nen chua co con so chinh thuc. UOC TAM (tu bang thong ly thuyet, CHUA do): tao toi da ~4 tai khoan MT5 demo. Chay `b may do --nhanh` luc may ranh (~1 phut; day du `b may do` ~5 phut) de co so that.
CHU DU AN CAN LAM:
  1. Them RAM CUNG LOAI voi thanh dang co (DDR4 32.0 GB, 2133 MT/s; ma hang M386A4G40DM0-CPB) vao khe KHAC KENH (xem so tay bo mach: khe vi tri 1 cua moi kenh). Them 1 thanh: 1 -> 2 kenh, bang thong ly thuyet gap 2.0 lan; them du 3 thanh: 4 kenh, gap 4.0 lan. Khong tron RDIMM voi LRDIMM; chua chac thi gui anh nhan thanh dang co de chon dung loai.
  2. O C: con 16.7 GB: don thu muc tam / backups / cache tester (xem muc mt5.gb_tester trong `b may quet`) hoac chuyen du lieu sang o khac
  3. File trang (pagefile): dat 1 file CO DINH tren o HDD moi (goi y 62 GB, dau = toi da, khong de Windows tu co gian) lam LUOI AN TOAN chong loi het bo nho (da xay ra 13/09). Khong lam bo nho lam viec: HDD cham ~100 lan SSD, neu phai doc/ghi lien tuc thi may dung hinh. Giu file trang nho tren SSD. Xem tai_lieu/MAY_NHA_TOI_UU.md
PHIEN NHA / MAY TU LAM:
  - Dat tran CPU cua he = 78 (giua dai 75-80): `b tran-cpu 78` (mac dinh trong code la 85)
SO LIEU:
  - May: Intel(R) Xeon(R) CPU E5-2630 v4 @ 2.20GHz, 10 nhan / 20 luong, RAM 32.0 GB (1 thanh, khe trong 15, 1 kenh dang dung).
